newsitem.title: LATVIA: Low share activity in Latvia in last 1996 trade.
newsitem.headline: Low share activity in Latvia in last 1996 trade.

text.p: Trading on the Latvian bourse was slow as expected on Friday as the market traded for the last time in 1996. The market reopens on January 2.
Overall market turnover reached 14,640 lats and Daugavpils Chain manufacturer on the secondary list was the most traded on 5,883 lats. Its price rose to 1.11 lats from 1.08.
Other secondary list shares, Jekabpils Sugar refinery and Mangali Shipyard, were also among the few traded, turning over 560 lats and 825 lats of stock respectively.
Jekabpils sugar rose to 0.28 from 0.25 santimes and Mangali Shipyard went up to 0.55 santime from 0.48.
On the official market Riga Transport Fleet was the most traded on 3,084 lats with its shares rising to 0.99 from 0.95 santime.
Riga Stock Exchange renews trading after the New Year on January 2, with four sessions a week on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. The fourth trading day was introduced late December.
